name: web-black-contact-hero-with-availability-dot-and-light-two-tone-headline
title: Black closing hero 'Let's work together' in light sans with the second word faded, a green availability dot and a circular arrow button
whatItIs: A black page with a small caps line with a green dot 'AVAILABLE FOR PROJECTS', a very large light white 'Let's work' above a grey faded 'together', a thin circular button with a diagonal arrow, a grey invitation paragraph and an email address in small caps.
whatItMeans: Quiet and confident; a faded second word and a tiny green dot make an invitation feel calm.
techniques: Fade the second line of a big light headline.
Use a small green availability dot.
Add a thin circular arrow button.

vocabulary.definition: A green dot signalling open for work.
A headline line in lower contrast.
A ring button with a diagonal arrow.
An email set in tiny uppercase.
